en.description:
Quiz Circuit — The Ultimate Apple Watch Trivia Racer

Race, think fast, and beat the clock.

Quiz Circuit is a fast-paced trivia racing game designed exclusively for Apple Watch. Use the Digital Crown to steer your kart around a glowing circular track and drive into the correct answer zone before time runs out.

60 seconds. Endless fun.

 HOW IT WORKS
• Spin the Digital Crown to steer left or right  
• Drive into the correct answer lane  
• Answer as many questions as you can in 60 seconds  
• Build your high score and improve your reaction time  

GAME MODES
Math — Quick arithmetic challenges  
Flags — Identify countries from pixel-style flags  
Animals — Recognize animals from icons  
Music — Match tones to notes (C, D, E, F, G, A, B)  
Transport — Identify vehicles from icons  

FEATURES
• Designed for Apple Watch gameplay  
• Simple controls, fast sessions  
• Bright neon visuals and smooth performance  
• Perfect for quick play anytime, anywhere  

Can you master the circuit and become the ultimate quiz racer?

Download Quiz Circuit and start racing today.
en.releaseNotes:
Fixed France flag displaying as horizontal stripes instead of correct vertical blue-white-red
Fixed flag rendering showing white block on reverse side when rotating in 3D
Fixed Italian flag showing incorrect stripe pattern
Fixed geography mode not displaying country names or registering answer selection
Fixed flag visibility being obscured by lane transparency
Fixed duplicate answer processing causing missed inputs in flag mode
Fixed menu elements being cut off on smaller Apple Watch screens
